INSTITUTE OF BANKING PERSONNEL SELECTION
COMMON RECRUITMENT PROCESS FOR RECRUITMENT OF PROBATIONARY OFFICERS / MANAGEMENT TRAINEES
IN PARTICIPATING BANKS (CRP PO/MT-XVI FOR VACANCIES OF 2026-27)

Online registration including edit/modification of application by candidates: 01.08.2026 to 21.08.2026
Online Examination - Preliminary: 19.10.2026 and 20.10.2026
Online Examination - Main: 30.11.2026
Conduct of Interview: January/February 2027
Provisional Allotment: April 2027
Total tentative vacancies: 3955 in 11 participating public sector banks.
